attempts.observation: The project adapter returned zero tracks; the preliminary runner stopped before caption HTTP.
attempts.resolution: Kept the adapter failure as a platform integration result and fetched the metadata-listed, licensed VTT directly for parser-only acceptance.

attempts.observation: The local Python/httpx route could not connect; no caption file was saved by this attempt.
attempts.resolution: Used PowerShell Invoke-WebRequest with explicit sandbox escalation to the same public Internet Archive endpoint.

attempts.observation: The elevated collector could not write directly into the ACL-restricted raw-extra folder; caption GET did not start.
attempts.resolution: Staged the public file under the report workspace, then copied it to raw-extra with SHA-256 and size verification under restricted folder ACLs.

attempts.observation: The helper omitted UTF-8 Encoding initialization; caption GET did not start.
attempts.resolution: Initialized UTF8Encoding(false), then reran all four listed caption GETs successfully.

attempts.observation: The first finalizer copied and hash-verified the first caption, then stopped at a bare true literal.
attempts.resolution: Changed it to $true and reran idempotently; all four staged files matched receipt hashes and were copied.

note: Helper and sandbox issues are preserved here but excluded from sample parser/platform pass-rate denominators. Application track-discovery results are recorded separately in test-results.json.
